translations.literal: In the fifth month the mobilization was stood down.
translations.idiomatic: The mobilization was discontinued in the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 是時胡賊又圍襄陽，征西將軍庾亮遣寧距退之。

translations.literal: At that time the barbarian raiders again besieged Xiangyang; the Campaign-General of the West Yu Liang sent Ning to repel and drive them back.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the raiders besieged Xiangyang again; Yu Liang, Campaign-General of the West, sent Ning to beat them back.

translations.literal: In the sixth month there was drought.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth month brought drought.

sentences.zh: 咸康元年八月戊戌，熒惑入東井。

translations.literal: On wuxu day in the eighth month of the first year of Xiankang Mars entered the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuxu day in the eighth month of Xiankang 1 Mars entered the Eastern Well asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "When there is no war, war will arise;
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "If there is no war, war will flare up;

translations.literal: when there is war, war will cease."
translations.idiomatic: if there is war, war will stop."

translations.literal: That summer troops were raised and frontier posts established in succession.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the court mobilized troops and established a chain of frontier garrisons.

sentences.zh: 加王導大司馬，以備胡賊。

translations.literal: Wang Dao was additionally made Grand Marshal to guard against the barbarian raiders.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dao was further appointed Grand Marshal to prepare against the raiders.

sentences.zh: 咸康元年三月丙戌，月入昴。

translations.literal: On bingxu day in the third month of the first year of Xiankang the moon entered the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingxu day in the third month of Xiankang 1 the moon entered the Hairy Head asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The barbarian king will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A barbarian king will die."

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the moon encroached on the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the moon crossed the Hairy Head.

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year the moon again encroached on the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year the moon crossed the Hairy Head again.

translations.literal: The prognostication was the same.
translations.idiomatic: The reading was the same.

sentences.zh: 咸和三年，石虎發眾七萬，四年二月，自襲段遼于薊，遼奔敗。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianhe Shi Hu mobilized seventy thousand men; in the second month of the fourth year he personally attacked Duan Liao at Ji, and Liao fled in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianhe 3 Shi Hu raised an army of seventy thousand; in the second month of the fourth year he personally attacked Duan Liao at Ji, and Liao fled in defeat.

sentences.zh: 又攻慕容皝於棘城，不剋引退，皝追之，殺數百人。

translations.literal: He again attacked Murong Huang at Jicheng, failed to take it and withdrew; Huang pursued and killed several hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: He next attacked Murong Huang at Jicheng, failed to capture it, and retreated; Huang pursued and cut down several hundred men.

sentences.zh: 虎留其將麻秋屯令支，皝破秋，并虜遼殺之。

translations.literal: Hu left his general Ma Qiu stationed at Lingzhi; Huang defeated Qiu, captured Liao as well, and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Hu left his general Ma Qiu garrisoned at Lingzhi; Huang routed Qiu, captured Liao in the bargain, and had him killed.

sentences.zh: 咸康二年正月辛巳，彗星夕見西方，在奎。

translations.literal: On xinsi day in the first month of the second year of Xiankang a comet appeared at evening in the west, at Kui.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinsi day in the first month of Xiankang 2 a comet blazed at dusk in the west within the Legs asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "It portends war and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War and death will follow."

translations.literal: Kui also corresponds to frontier warfare."
translations.idiomatic: The Legs asterism also presides over frontier armies."

sentences.zh: 」四年，石虎伐慕容皝不剋，皝追擊之，又破麻秋。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Shi Hu campaigned against Murong Huang without success; Huang pursued and defeated him, and again routed Ma Qiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Shi Hu attacked Murong Huang without success; Huang counterattacked and again destroyed Ma Qiu.

translations.literal: At that time Huang declared himself a vassal—this answered the portent of frontier warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Huang had by then submitted as a vassal—the fulfillment of the frontier-war omen.

sentences.zh: 咸康二年正月辛卯，月犯房南第二星。

translations.literal: On xinmao day in the first month of the second year of Xiankang the moon encroached on the second star south of the Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinmao day in the first month of Xiankang 2 the moon trespassed against the second star south of the Chamber asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Generals and ministers will suffer distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Generals and ministers will be afflicted."

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year Chancellor Wang Dao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year Chancellor Wang Dao died.

translations.literal: In the eighth month Grand Commandant Chi Jian died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Grand Commandant Chi Jian died.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，征西大將軍庾亮薨。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year Campaign-General of the West Yu Liang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year Yu Liang, Campaign-General of the West, died.

sentences.zh: 咸康二年九月庚寅，太白犯南斗，因晝見。

translations.literal: On gengyin day in the ninth month of the second year of Xiankang Venus encroached on the Southern Dipper and was also visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengyin day in the ninth month of Xiankang 2 Venus trespassed against the Southern Dipper and shone in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「斗為宰相，又揚州分，金犯之，死喪象。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Dipper stands for the chancellor; it is also the Yangzhou division; when Metal encroaches upon it, it is an image of death and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read thus: "The Dipper represents the chancellor and also the Yangzhou region; Venus trespassing against it foretells death and mourning.

translations.literal: Daytime visibility signifies disloyal subjects, and also war and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: Daytime visibility betokens disloyal subjects and likewise war and slaughter."

translations.literal: In the third year Shi Hu presumptuously styled himself Heavenly King.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Shi Hu usurped the title Heavenly King.

sentences.zh: 四年，虎滅段遼而敗於慕容皝。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Hu destroyed Duan Liao but was defeated by Murong Huang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Hu destroyed Duan Liao but was defeated by Murong Huang.

translations.literal: Huang was a vassal of the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Huang was a tributary subject of the court—the disloyal-subject reading inverted.

translations.literal: In the fifth year Wang Dao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Wang Dao died.

sentences.zh: 咸康三年六月辛未，有流星大如二斗魁，色青，赤光耀地，出奎中，沒婁北。

translations.literal: On xinwei day in the sixth month of the third year of Xiankang a meteor as large as two Dipper ladles, green in color with a red brilliance lighting the ground, issued from within Kui and set north of Bond.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinwei day in the sixth month of Xiankang 3 a meteor the size of two ladle-bowls, blue-green with a red glow that lit the earth, shot out from the Legs asterism and vanished north of Bond.

translations.literal: According to the prognostications it portends famine and the failure of the five grains to keep in store.
translations.idiomatic: The established reading was famine—the five grains would not keep in store.

translations.literal: That month there was great drought.
translations.idiomatic: That month brought severe drought.

sentences.zh: 咸康三年八月，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積屍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Xiankang Mars entered the Carriage Ghost and encroached on Accumulated Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Xiankang 3 Mars entered the Carriage Ghost asterism and trespassed against Accumulated Corpses.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Nobles will suffer distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The high-born will know affliction."

sentences.zh: 」三年八月甲戌，月犯東井距星。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day in the eighth month of the third year the moon encroached on the distance star of the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiaxu day in the eighth month of the third year the moon trespassed against the Eastern Well's separating star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The state will suffer distress; a general will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The realm will be troubled; a general will perish."

translations.literal: On wuzi day in the ninth month of the third year the moon encroached on the Establishment stars.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuzi day in the ninth month of the third year the moon trespassed against the Establishment stars.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The chancellor will be replaced."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The chief minister will be changed."

translations.literal: One interpretation reads: "A great general will die."
translations.idiomatic: A second reading: "A great general will die."

sentences.zh: 」五年，丞相王導薨，庾氷代輔政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Chancellor Wang Dao died, and Yu Bing succeeded to assist in government.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Chancellor Wang Dao died, and Yu Bing took up the reins of government.

sentences.zh: 太尉郗鑒、征西大將軍庾亮薨。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Chi Jian and Campaign-General of the West Yu Liang died.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Chi Jian and Yu Liang, Campaign-General of the West, also died.

sentences.zh: 咸康三年十一月乙丑，太白犯歲星。

translations.literal: On yichou day in the eleventh month of the third year of Xiankang Venus encroached on Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On a yichou day in the eleventh month of Xiankang 3 Venus trespassed against Jupiter.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "It portends war and famine."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War and famine will follow."

sentences.zh: 」四年二月，石虎破幽州，遷其人萬餘家。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year Shi Hu broke You Province and relocated more than ten thousand of its households.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year Shi Hu overran You Province and resettled more than ten thousand households.

translations.literal: Li Shou killed Li Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shou killed Li Qi.

sentences.zh: 五年，胡眾五萬寇沔南，略七千餘家而去。

translations.literal: In the fifth year fifty thousand barbarian troops raided south of the Mian River, plundered more than seven thousand households, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year a barbarian force of fifty thousand raided south of the Mian, looted more than seven thousand households, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 又騎二萬圍陷邾城，殺略五千餘人。

translations.literal: A further twenty thousand horsemen besieged and captured Zhucheng, killing and plundering more than five thousand people.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty thousand more cavalry then besieged Zhucheng, took it, and killed or plundered more than five thousand people.

sentences.zh: 咸康四年四月己巳，太白晝見在柳。

translations.literal: On jisi day in the fourth month of the fourth year of Xiankang Venus was visible by day in the Willow.
translations.idiomatic: On a jisi day in the fourth month of Xiankang 4 Venus shone in broad daylight within the Willow asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "It portends war and disloyal subjects."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War and treason will follow."

translations.literal: On yisi day in the seventh month the moon veiled Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On a yisi day in the seventh month the moon obscured Venus.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "A king will lose territory; a great army will rise."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A sovereign will lose land, and great armies will take the field."

sentences.zh: 」明年，胡賊大寇沔南，陷邾城，豫州刺史毛寶、西陽太守樊峻皆棄城投江死。

translations.literal: The next year the barbarian raiders mounted a great incursion south of the Mian, captured Zhucheng, and Prefect of Yu Province Mao Bao and Administrator of Xiyang Fan Jun both abandoned their cities, cast themselves into the river, and died.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the raiders launched a major attack south of the Mian, took Zhucheng, and Mao Bao, Prefect of Yu, and Fan Jun, Administrator of Xiyang, both abandoned their posts, threw themselves into the river, and drowned.

sentences.zh: 於是內外戒嚴，左衞桓監、匡術等諸軍至武昌，乃退。

translations.literal: Thereupon internal and external alerts were raised; the armies of Left Guard Huan Jian, Kuang Shu, and others reached Wuchang, and the raiders then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The court then mobilized for defense on every front; the armies of Huan Jian of the Left Guard, Kuang Shu, and others reached Wuchang, and only then did the raiders retreat.

sentences.zh: 七年，慕容皝自稱為燕王。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Murong Huang styled himself King of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Murong Huang declared himself King of Yan.

sentences.zh: 咸康四年五月戊午，熒惑犯右執法。

translations.literal: On wuwu day in the fifth month of the fourth year of Xiankang Mars encroached on the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuwu day in the fifth month of Xiankang 4 Mars trespassed against the Right Law Enforcer star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "A great minister will die; those in power will suffer distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A chief minister will perish, and the men who hold the reins will be afflicted."

translations.literal: In the ninth month Venus encroached on the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Venus trespassed against the Right Law Enforcer star.

sentences.zh: 案占，「五星災同，金火尤甚。

translations.literal: According to the prognostications, "When the five stars share the same calamity, Metal and Fire are especially severe."
translations.idiomatic: The established reading held that when the five planets share a calamity, Venus and Mars are especially dire.

translations.literal: On wuzi day in the eleventh month Venus encroached on the upper star of the Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuzi day in the eleventh month Venus trespassed against the upper star of the Chamber asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The chief minister will suffer distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The senior minister will be afflicted."

sentences.zh: 」五年七月己酉，月犯房上星，亦同占。

translations.literal: On jiyou day in the seventh month of the fifth year the moon encroached on the upper star of the Chamber—the prognostication was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiyou day in the seventh month of the fifth year the moon trespassed against the upper star of the Chamber—the reading was the same.

translations.literal: On gengshen day of that month Chancellor Wang Dao died.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengshen day that same month Chancellor Wang Dao died.

sentences.zh: 咸康五年四月辛未，月犯歲星，在胃。

translations.literal: On xinwei day in the fourth month of the fifth year of Xiankang the moon encroached on Jupiter in the Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinwei day in the fourth month of Xiankang 5 the moon trespassed against Jupiter in the Stomach asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The state will suffer famine and the people will scatter."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Famine will grip the realm and the people will flee."

translations.literal: On yiwei day the moon encroached on the distance star of the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiwei day the moon trespassed against the Net's separating star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "War will arise."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War will break out."

translations.literal: That same night the moon again encroached on Jupiter in the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: That same night the moon trespassed against Jupiter again, now in the Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 及冬，有沔南、邾城之敗，百姓流亡萬餘家。

translations.literal: By winter came the defeats at south of the Mian and Zhucheng, and more than ten thousand households of common people fled into exile.
translations.idiomatic: Before winter was out came the disasters at the Mian south and Zhucheng, and more than ten thousand common households were driven into flight.

sentences.zh: 咸康六年二月庚午朔，流星大如斗，光耀地，出天市，西行入太微。

translations.literal: On the gengwu new moon of the second month of the sixth year of Xiankang a meteor as large as a ladle blazed to light the ground, issued from the Celestial Market, traveled west, and entered Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: At the gengwu new moon in the second month of Xiankang 6 a meteor the size of a dipper ladle lit the earth as it shot out of the Celestial Market Enclosure, passed westward, and entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "A great man will meet it."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A great man will bear the blow."

translations.literal: On yiwei day Venus entered the moon.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiwei day Venus passed into the moon.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The ruler will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The sovereign will die."

translations.literal: On jiawu day in the fourth month the moon encroached on Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiawu day in the fourth month the moon trespassed against Venus.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The ruler will be harmed by it."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The sovereign will be afflicted."

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year Emperor Cheng died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year Emperor Cheng died.

sentences.zh: 咸康六年三月甲寅，熒惑從行犯太微上將星。

translations.literal: On jiayin day in the third month of the sixth year of Xiankang Mars, moving in tandem, encroached on the Senior General star of Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiayin day in the third month of Xiankang 6 Mars, traveling in company, trespassed against the Senior General star in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The senior general will suffer distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The senior general will be afflicted."

translations.literal: On dingchou day in the fourth month Mars encroached on the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingchou day in the fourth month Mars trespassed against the Right Law Enforcer star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The law enforcer will suffer distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The law-enforcer will be afflicted."

translations.literal: On yihai day in the sixth month the moon encroached on the central star of the Lead Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On a yihai day in the sixth month the moon trespassed against the central star of the Lead Ox asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "A great general will suffer distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A great general will be afflicted."

sentences.zh: 」是時尚書令何充為執法，有譴欲避其咎，明年，求為中書令。

translations.literal: At that time Director of the Masters of Writing He Chong held the law-enforcer's charge, received reproof and wished to escape the penalty; the next year he sought appointment as Director of the Palace Writers.
translations.idiomatic: He Chong, Director of the Masters of Writing, then held the law-enforcer's post; censured and anxious to escape blame, he petitioned the following year to be made Director of the Palace Writers.

sentences.zh: 建元二年，庾冰薨，皆大將執政之應也。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyuan Yu Bing died—all fulfillments of the portents for great generals and those who hold power.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyuan 2 Yu Bing died—these were all fulfillments of the omens for great generals and the men who ruled.

sentences.zh: 是歲正月，征西將軍庾亮薨。

translations.literal: In the first month of that year Campaign-General of the West Yu Liang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of that year Yu Liang, Campaign-General of the West, died.

translations.literal: In the third month Mars encroached on the Senior General.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Mars trespassed against the Senior General star.

translations.literal: In the ninth month Shi Hu's great general Kui An died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Kui An, a great general of Shi Hu, died.

translations.literal: Years afterward Yu Bing finally died.
translations.idiomatic: Only after several more years did Yu Bing die.

sentences.zh: 豈冰能修德，移禍於夔安乎？

translations.literal: Could it be that Bing was able to cultivate virtue and shift calamity onto Kui An?
translations.idiomatic: Could Yu Bing, by cultivating virtue, have diverted misfortune onto Kui An?

sentences.zh: 咸康六年四月丙午，太白犯畢距星。

translations.literal: On bingwu day in the fourth month of the sixth year of Xiankang Venus encroached on the distance star of the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingwu day in the fourth month of Xiankang 6 Venus trespassed against the Net's separating star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Arms and armor will rise."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War will break out."

translations.literal: A second reading: "The chief consort will suffer distress."
translations.idiomatic: A second interpretation: "The empress will be afflicted."

translations.literal: On yimao day in the sixth month Venus encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On a yimao day in the sixth month Venus trespassed against the great star of Xuanyuan.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The chief consort will suffer distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The empress will be afflicted."

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year Empress Du died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Xiankang 7 Empress Du died.

sentences.zh: 咸康七年三月壬午，月犯房。

translations.literal: On renwu day in the third month of the seventh year of Xiankang the moon encroached on the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a renwu day in the third month of Xiankang 7 the moon trespassed against the Room asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Generals and ministers will suffer distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Generals and chief ministers will be afflicted."

sentences.zh: 」八年六月，熒惑犯房上第二星。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year Mars encroached on the second star above the Room.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Xiankang 8 Mars trespassed against the second star above the Room asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The secondary minister will suffer distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The second-ranking minister will be afflicted."

sentences.zh: 」建元二年，車騎將軍江州刺史庾冰薨。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyuan General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jiang Province Yu Bing died.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyuan 2 Yu Bing, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jiang Province, died.

sentences.zh: 是時驃騎將軍何充居內，冰為次相也。

translations.literal: At that time General of Fast Cavalry He Chong held office within the capital, and Bing was the secondary minister.
translations.idiomatic: He Chong, General of Fast Cavalry, then held sway at court, while Yu Bing ranked as the second minister.

sentences.zh: 咸康七年四月己丑，太白入輿鬼。

translations.literal: On jichou day in the fourth month of the seventh year of Xiankang Venus entered the Carriage Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On a jichou day in the fourth month of Xiankang 7 Venus entered the Carriage Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Arms and armor will rise."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War will break out."

translations.literal: In the fifth month Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Venus appeared in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 以晷度推之，非秦、魏，則楚也。

translations.literal: Calculating by gnomon measures, if not Qin or Wei, then it must be Chu.
translations.idiomatic: By reckoning from the gnomon readings, the region affected was neither Qin nor Wei but Chu.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Ministers grow strong; there will be war."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Subjects grow overmighty; war will follow."

translations.literal: On xinchou day in the eighth month the moon encroached on the Carriage Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinchou day in the eighth month the moon trespassed against the Carriage Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The ruler will suffer distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The sovereign will be afflicted."

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year Emperor Cheng died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Xiankang 8 Emperor Cheng died.

sentences.zh: 咸康八年八月壬寅，月犯畢赤星。

translations.literal: On renyin day in the eighth month of the eighth year of Xiankang the moon encroached on the red star of the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On a renyin day in the eighth month of Xiankang 8 the moon trespassed against the Net's red star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The inferior encroaches on the superior; arms and armor will rise."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The low will trespass against the high; war will break out."

translations.literal: In the tenth month the moon again occulted the red star of the Net.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the moon once more covered the Net's red star.

translations.literal: The prognostication is the same.
translations.idiomatic: The omen reading was the same.

translations.literal: On jiyou day Venus encroached on Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiyou day Venus trespassed against Mars.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Great armies will rise."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Major war will break out."

sentences.zh: 」其後庾翼大發兵謀伐胡，專制上流，朝廷憚之。

translations.literal: Afterward Yu Yi mustered troops on a great scale, plotted to attack the barbarians, held sole power over the upper reaches, and the court feared him.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Yu Yi raised a great army intending to strike the northern tribes, dominated the upper Yangzi unchallenged, and the court stood in awe of him.

sentences.zh: 康帝建元元年正月壬午，太白入昴。

translations.literal: On renwu day in the first month of the first year of Jianyuan under Emperor Kang Venus entered the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On a renwu day in the first month of Jianyuan 1, during the reign of Emperor Kang, Venus entered the Hairy Head asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be war in the Zhao region."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Arms will rise in the Zhao territories."

translations.literal: It also reads: "War will rise throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: Another reading: "War will break out across the empire."

translations.literal: On yiyou day in the fourth month Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiyou day in the fourth month Venus appeared in broad daylight.

translations.literal: On dingwei day in the eighth month Venus encroached on Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingwei day in the eighth month Venus trespassed against Jupiter.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be great armies."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Major warfare will erupt."

sentences.zh: 」是年，石虎殺其太子邃及其妻子徒屬二百餘人。

translations.literal: That year Shi Hu killed his heir apparent Sui and more than two hundred of his wives, children, and followers.
translations.idiomatic: That year Shi Hu executed his crown prince Sui along with more than two hundred wives, children, and dependents.

sentences.zh: 又遣將劉寧寇沒狄道，又使將張舉將萬餘人屯薊東，謀慕容皝。

translations.literal: He also sent the general Liu Ning to raid and capture Didao, and dispatched the general Zhang Ju with more than ten thousand men to encamp east of Ji, plotting against Murong Huang.
translations.idiomatic: He further sent Liu Ning to raid and seize Didao, and Zhang Ju with over ten thousand troops to camp east of Ji in a move against Murong Huang.

sentences.zh: 建元元年十一月六日，彗星見亢，長七尺，尾白色。

translations.literal: On the sixth day of the eleventh month of the first year of Jianyuan a comet appeared at Kang, seven feet long, with a white tail.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth day of the eleventh month of Jianyuan 1 a comet showed at the Neck asterism, seven feet in length, its tail white.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Kang corresponds to the court and presides over war and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Kang is the asterism of the imperial court and governs war and funeral calamity."

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year Emperor Kang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Jianyuan 2 Emperor Kang died.

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianyuan Jupiter encroached on the Celestial Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyuan 1 Jupiter trespassed against the Celestial Gate star.

sentences.zh: 安西將軍庾翼與兄冰書曰：「歲星犯天關，占云：『關梁當澁。

translations.literal: Campaign-General of the West Yu Yi wrote to his elder brother Bing: "Jupiter encroached on the Celestial Gate; the prognostication says: 'Passes and bridges ought to be obstructed.'"
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yi, Campaign-General of the West, wrote to his elder brother Bing: "Jupiter has trespassed against the Celestial Gate; the reading runs: 'Passes and bridges should be blocked.'"

sentences.zh: 』比來江東無他故，江道亦不艱難；

translations.literal: Lately in the lands east of the river there has been no other cause, and the river route is not difficult either;
translations.idiomatic: "Yet of late nothing untoward has befallen the lands east of the Yangzi, and the river routes have not grown hard;

sentences.zh: 而石虎頻年再閉關不通信使，此復是天公憒憒無皁白之徵也。」

translations.literal: yet Shi Hu year after year has twice closed the passes and cut off envoys—this again is a sign that Heaven is muddled and offers no clear black-or-white portent."
translations.idiomatic: meanwhile Shi Hu has repeatedly shut the passes and blocked envoys these several years—once again Heaven seems confused, giving no plain sign of right or wrong."

sentences.zh: 建元二年閏月乙酉，太白犯斗。

translations.literal: On yiyou day in the intercalary month of the second year of Jianyuan Venus encroached on the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiyou day in the intercalary month of Jianyuan 2 Venus trespassed against the Dipper asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be mourning; the realm will receive ranks and stipends."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Mourning will come, and the empire will receive ennoblements and stipends."

sentences.zh: 」九月，康帝崩，太子立，大赦賜爵也。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Emperor Kang died, the heir apparent was enthroned, and there was a general amnesty and bestowal of ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Emperor Kang died; the crown prince ascended the throne, and a general amnesty with ennoblements followed.

sentences.zh: 晉穆帝永和元年正月丁丑，月入畢。

translations.literal: On dingchou day in the first month of the first year of Yonghe under Emperor Mu of Jin the moon entered the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingchou day in the first month of Yonghe 1, during the reign of Emperor Mu of Jin, the moon entered the Net asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Armies will rise on a great scale."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War will erupt on a large scale."

translations.literal: On wuyin day the moon encroached on the Celestial Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuyin day the moon trespassed against the Celestial Gate star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有亂臣更天子之法。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There are rebellious ministers who will alter the Son of Heaven's laws."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Rebellious ministers will change the sovereign's institutions."

translations.literal: On xinsi day in the fifth month Venus was visible in daylight in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinsi day in the fifth month Venus shone in broad daylight within the Eastern Well asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Ministers grow strong; there will be war in Qin."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Subjects grow overmighty; war will rise in the Qin region."

translations.literal: On xinchou day in the sixth month it entered Taiwei and encroached on the southwestern Screen.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinchou day in the sixth month Venus entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and trespassed against the southwestern Screen star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Among assisting ministers some will be dismissed and removed."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A minister-advisor will be dismissed from office."

translations.literal: In the seventh and eighth months the moon in both cases encroached on the Net.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh and eighth months the moon trespassed against the Net both times.

translations.literal: The prognostication is the same as in the first month.
translations.idiomatic: The omen reading matched that of the first month.

translations.literal: On jiwei day the moon encroached on the Carriage Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiwei day the moon trespassed against the Carriage Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Great ministers will be executed."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A chief minister will be put to death."

translations.literal: On gengxu day in the ninth month the moon again encroached on the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengxu day in the ninth month the moon once more trespassed against the Net asterism.

sentences.zh: 是年初，庾翼在襄陽，七月，翼疾將終，輒以子爰之為荊州刺史，代己任，爰之尋被廢。

translations.literal: At the beginning of that year Yu Yi was at Xiangyang; in the seventh month, as Yi's illness was nearing its end, he forthwith appointed his son Yuanzhi Governor of Jing Province to succeed him in office; Yuanzhi was soon dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Early that year Yu Yi was at Xiangyang; in the seventh month, as his illness neared its end, he installed his son Yuanzhi as Governor of Jing Province in his stead—Yuanzhi was soon removed from office.

sentences.zh: 明年，桓溫又輒率眾伐蜀，執李勢，送至京都。

translations.literal: The next year Huan Wen again on his own authority led the host to attack Shu, captured Li Shi, and sent him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Huan Wen likewise took troops on his own authority to invade Shu, seized Li Shi, and had him conveyed to the capital.

translations.literal: Shu is originally Qin territory.
translations.idiomatic: Shu lay within the Qin region—the very territory the omen had indicated.

sentences.zh: 永和二年二月壬子，月犯房上星。

translations.literal: On renzi day in the second month of the second year of Yonghe the moon encroached on the star above the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a renzi day in the second month of Yonghe 2 the moon trespassed against the star above the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 四月丙戌，月又犯房上星。

translations.literal: On bingxu day in the fourth month the moon again encroached on the star above the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingxu day in the fourth month the moon once more trespassed against the star above the Room asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication is the same as before.
translations.idiomatic: The omen reading was the same as earlier.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，太白犯左執法。

translations.literal: On renshen day in the eighth month Venus encroached on the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a renshen day in the eighth month Venus trespassed against the Left Law Enforcer star.

translations.literal: That year Minister over the Masses Cai Mo was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: That year Cai Mo, Minister over the Masses, was deposed.

sentences.zh: 永和三年正月壬午，月犯南斗第五星。

translations.literal: On renwu day in the first month of the third year of Yonghe the moon encroached on the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On a renwu day in the first month of Yonghe 3 the moon trespassed against the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "A general will die; close attendants will depart."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A general will die and court intimates will be removed."

sentences.zh: 」五月壬申，月犯南斗第四星，因入魁。

translations.literal: On renshen day in the fifth month the moon encroached on the fourth star of the Southern Dipper and thereby entered the Dipper's bowl.
translations.idiomatic: On a renshen day in the fifth month the moon trespassed against the fourth star of the Southern Dipper and passed into the Dipper's head.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be war."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War will break out."

translations.literal: A second reading: "There will be a general amnesty."
translations.idiomatic: A second interpretation: "A general amnesty will be proclaimed."

translations.literal: In the sixth month the moon encroached on the distance star of the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the moon trespassed against the Eastern Well's separating star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "A general will die; the state will have distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A general will die and the realm will know alarm."

translations.literal: On wuxu day the moon encroached on the Five Feudal Lords.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuxu day the moon trespassed against the Five Feudal Lords asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Feudal lords will be executed."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Regional lords will be put to death."

sentences.zh: 」九月庚寅，太白犯南斗第五星。

translations.literal: On gengyin day in the ninth month Venus encroached on the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengyin day in the ninth month Venus trespassed against the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be mourning and armies."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Mourning and war will follow."

sentences.zh: 」四年七月丙申，太白犯左執法。

translations.literal: On bingshen day in the seventh month of the fourth year Venus encroached on the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingshen day in the seventh month of Yonghe 4 Venus trespassed against the Left Law Enforcer star.

translations.literal: On jiayin day the moon encroached on the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiayin day the moon trespassed against the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，月入南斗犯第二星。

translations.literal: On dingsi day the moon entered the Southern Dipper and encroached on the second star.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingsi day the moon entered the Southern Dipper and trespassed against its second star.

translations.literal: On yichou day Venus encroached on the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a yichou day Venus trespassed against the Left Law Enforcer star.

translations.literal: The prognostications are all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The omen readings were all the same as given above.

translations.literal: On jiaxu day in the tenth month the moon encroached on Kang.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiaxu day in the tenth month the moon trespassed against the Neck asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "War will rise; army generals will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War will break out and field commanders will die."

translations.literal: On wuxu day in the eleventh month it encroached on the Senior General star.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuxu day in the eleventh month the moon trespassed against the Senior General star.

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year there was a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Yonghe 3 a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 是月，陳逵征壽春，敗而還。

translations.literal: That month Chen Kui campaigned against Shouchun, was defeated, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Chen Kui marched on Shouchun, was beaten, and retreated.

sentences.zh: 七月，氐蜀餘寇反亂益土。

translations.literal: In the seventh month remnant Di bandits in Shu rebelled and threw Yizhou into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month surviving Di rebels in Shu rose in revolt and ravaged the Yizhou region.

translations.literal: In the ninth month Shi Hu campaigned against Liang Province but did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Shi Hu invaded Liang Province without success.

sentences.zh: 永和四年四月，太白入昴。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year of Yonghe Venus entered the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Yonghe 4 Venus entered the Hairy Head asterism.

translations.literal: In the fifth month Mars entered the Garrison and encroached on Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Mars entered the Garrison asterism and trespassed against Saturn.

translations.literal: In the seventh month Venus encroached on Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Venus trespassed against Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 占在趙，及為兵喪，女主憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication applies to Zhao, and also signifies war and mourning and distress for the chief consort.
translations.idiomatic: The reading applied to the Zhao region and foretold war, mourning, and affliction for the empress.

sentences.zh: 其年八月，石虎太子宣殺弟韜，宣亦死。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of that year Shi Hu's heir apparent Xuan killed his younger brother Tao; Xuan also died.
translations.idiomatic: That August Shi Hu's crown prince Xuan murdered his brother Tao—and Xuan himself was killed as well.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，石虎僭稱皇帝，尋病死。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year Shi Hu presumptuously styled himself emperor and soon died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yonghe 5 Shi Hu arrogated the imperial title; he soon sickened and died.

sentences.zh: 是年，褚裒北伐喪眾，又尋薨，太后素服。

translations.literal: That year Chu Pou's northern campaign lost the army; he soon died afterward, and the empress dowager wore plain mourning garb.
translations.idiomatic: That year Chu Pou's northern expedition ended in the loss of his forces; he died shortly thereafter, and the empress dowager put on plain mourning dress.

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year court assemblies abolished music.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yonghe 6 court sessions did away with ceremonial music.

sentences.zh: 永和五年四月丁未，太白犯東井。

translations.literal: On dingwei day in the fourth month of the fifth year of Yonghe Venus encroached on the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingwei day in the fourth month of Yonghe 5 Venus trespassed against the Eastern Well asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Qin will see warfare."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War would break out in Qin."

translations.literal: On wuxu day in the ninth month Venus encroached on the Left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuxu day in the ninth month Venus trespassed against the Left Horn star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends warfare."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "It foretold war."

translations.literal: In the tenth month the moon encroached on the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the moon crossed the Hairy Head asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The court will have distress; army generals will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The imperial court would know alarm, and field commanders would die."

sentences.zh: 」十一月乙卯，彗星見于亢，芒西向，色白，長一丈。

translations.literal: On yimao day in the eleventh month a comet appeared at Kang; its tail pointed west, its color was white, and it was one zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: On a yimao day in the eleventh month a comet showed at the Neck asterism, its tail streaming westward, white in color and one zhang in length.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends war and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "It foretold war and death."

translations.literal: In the eighth month of that year Chu Pou's northern levy of troops was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: That August Chu Pou's northern campaign to raise troops ended in defeat.

sentences.zh: 十月，關中二十餘壁舉兵歸從，石遵攻沒南陽。

translations.literal: In the tenth month more than twenty fortified camps in Guanzhong raised armies and submitted in allegiance; Shi Zun attacked and captured Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month over twenty walled strongholds in Guanzhong mustered forces and came over in submission, while Shi Zun stormed and took Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 十一月，冉閔殺石遵，又盡殺胡十餘萬人，於是中土大亂。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Ran Min killed Shi Zun and then slaughtered more than a hundred thousand Hu people; thereupon the Central Plain fell into great chaos.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Ran Min murdered Shi Zun and massacred over a hundred thousand non-Han peoples; the Central Plains were thrown into utter chaos.

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Chu Pou died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Chu Pou passed away.

sentences.zh: 八年，劉顯、苻健、慕容儁並僭號。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Liu Xian, Fu Jian, and Murong Jun all presumptuously styled themselves [kings].
translations.idiomatic: In Yonghe 8 Liu Xian, Fu Jian, and Murong Jun all usurped royal titles.

translations.literal: Yin Hao's northern expedition was defeated and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Hao's northern campaign failed and he was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 永和六年二月辛酉，月犯心大星。

translations.literal: On xinyou day in the second month of the sixth year of Yonghe the moon encroached on the great star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinyou day in the second month of Yonghe 6 the moon trespassed against the principal star of the Heart asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Great men will be troubled."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The mighty would grieve."

translations.literal: The Heart corresponds to the territory of Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Heart asterism governed the Yuzhou region.

translations.literal: On dingchou day the moon encroached on the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingchou day the moon trespassed against the Room asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Generals and chancellors will be troubled."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Commanders and ministers would know affliction."

translations.literal: On wuxu day in the third month Mars encroached on Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuxu day in the third month Mars trespassed against Jupiter.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends battle."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "It foretold combat."

translations.literal: On jichou day in the sixth month the moon encroached on the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On a jichou day in the sixth month the moon crossed the Hairy Head.

translations.literal: The prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The omen reading matched that given above.

translations.literal: On yiwei day the moon encroached on the Five Feudal Lords.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiwei day the moon trespassed against the Five Feudal Lords asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication matches that of the third year.
translations.idiomatic: The omen reading was the same as in Yonghe 3.

sentences.zh: 七月壬寅，月始出西方，犯左角。

translations.literal: On renyin day in the seventh month the moon first emerged in the west and encroached on the Left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: On a renyin day in the seventh month the moon rose first in the west and trespassed against the Left Horn star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Great General will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The commander-in-chief would perish."

translations.literal: Another reading: "Armies will rise throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: A second interpretation: "War would spread across the empire."

translations.literal: On dingwei day the moon encroached on the Winnowing Basket.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingwei day the moon trespassed against the Winnowing Basket asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Army generals will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Field commanders would die."

translations.literal: On bingyin day Mars encroached on the Halberd star.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingyin day Mars trespassed against the Halberd star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Great ministers will be executed."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "High officials would be put to death."

sentences.zh: 」八月辛卯，月犯左角，太白晝見在南斗，月犯右執法。

translations.literal: On xinmao day in the eighth month the moon encroached on the Left Horn; Venus was visible in daylight in the Southern Dipper; the moon encroached on the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinmao day in the eighth month the moon trespassed against the Left Horn; Venus shone by day in the Southern Dipper; and the moon crossed the Right Law Enforcer star.

translations.literal: The prognostications are all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The omen readings were all as given above.

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year Venus encroached on the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Yonghe 7 Venus trespassed against the Hairy Head asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The omen reading matched that given above.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積屍。

translations.literal: On yimao day Mars entered the Carriage Ghost and encroached on Accumulated Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: On a yimao day Mars entered the Carriage Ghost asterism and trespassed against Accumulated Corpses.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Nobles will be troubled."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The high-born would know distress."

translations.literal: On yiwei day in the fifth month Mars encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiwei day in the fifth month Mars trespassed against the principal star of Xuanyuan.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The chief consort will be troubled."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The empress would be afflicted."

translations.literal: Venus entered the mouth of the Net and encroached on the left thigh.
translations.idiomatic: Venus passed into the mouth of the Net asterism and trespassed against its left thigh star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Generals and chancellors will be affected."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The blow would fall on commanders and ministers."

translations.literal: On yihai day in the sixth month the moon encroached on the Winnowing Basket.
translations.idiomatic: On a yihai day in the sixth month the moon trespassed against the Winnowing Basket.

translations.literal: On bingzi day the moon encroached on the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingzi day the moon trespassed against the Dipper asterism.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，熒惑入太微，犯右執法。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and encroached on the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingchou day Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and trespassed against the Right Law Enforcer star.

translations.literal: On gengwu day in the eighth month Venus encroached on Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengwu day in the eighth month Venus trespassed against Xuanyuan.

translations.literal: On wuzi day Venus encroached on the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuzi day Venus trespassed against the Right Law Enforcer star.

translations.literal: The prognostications are all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The omen readings were all as given above.

sentences.zh: 七年，劉顯殺石祗及諸胡帥，中土大亂，戎、晉十萬數，各還舊土，互相侵略及疾疫死亡，能達者十二三。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Liu Xian killed Shi Zhi and the various Hu chieftains; the Central Plain fell into great chaos. Barbarians and Jin numbered in the hundreds of thousands; each returned to their native lands, mutually invading and ravaging one another, and dying of pestilence—only one or two in ten reached their destinations.
translations.idiomatic: In Yonghe 7 Liu Xian slaughtered Shi Zhi and the Hu warlords, plunging the Central Plains into chaos. Non-Han and Jin peoples by the tens of thousands each turned homeward, preying on one another as they went; plague took still more lives, and only one or two in ten survived the journey.

sentences.zh: 是年，桓溫輒以大眾求浮江入淮北伐，朝廷震懼。

translations.literal: That year Huan Wen repeatedly demanded to cross the river with a great host to enter the Huai and campaign north; the court was struck with terror.
translations.idiomatic: That year Huan Wen pressed again and again to ferry a massive army across the Yangtze into the Huai and strike north—throwing the court into alarm.

sentences.zh: 八年，豫州刺史謝尚討張遇，為苻雄所敗。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Inspector of Yuzhou Xie Shang campaigned against Zhang Yu and was defeated by Fu Xiong.
translations.idiomatic: In Yonghe 8 Xie Shang, inspector of Yuzhou, marched against Zhang Yu and was routed by Fu Xiong.

translations.literal: Yin Hao's northern expedition was defeated and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Hao's northern campaign failed and he was deposed.

sentences.zh: 十年，桓溫伐苻健，不克而還。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Huan Wen attacked Fu Jian but failed to overcome him and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In Yonghe 10 Huan Wen marched against Fu Jian, failed to prevail, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 永和八年三月戊戌，月犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: On wuxu day in the third month of the eighth year of Yonghe the moon encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuxu day in the third month of Yonghe 8 the moon trespassed against the principal star of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，月入南斗犯第二星。

translations.literal: On guichou day the moon entered the Southern Dipper and encroached on the second star.
translations.idiomatic: On a guichou day the moon entered the Southern Dipper and trespassed against its second star.

translations.literal: In the fifth month the moon encroached on the Heart star.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the moon trespassed against the Heart asterism.

translations.literal: On guiyou day in the fourth month the moon encroached on the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a guiyou day in the fourth month the moon trespassed against the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，日未入，有流星如三斗魁，從辰巳上東南行。

translations.literal: On xinsi day in the sixth month, before the sun had set, a meteor like the bowl of the Dipper appeared, traveling southeast from above chen and si.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinsi day in the sixth month, before sunset, a meteor the size of the Dipper's bowl streaked southeastward from the chen and si quadrants.

sentences.zh: 晷度推之，在箕、斗之間，蓋燕分也。

translations.literal: Calculating by gnomon measures, it lay between the Winnowing Basket and the Dipper—presumably the Yan region.
translations.idiomatic: By reckoning from the gnomon readings it fell between the Winnowing Basket and the Dipper—the celestial territory of Yan.

sentences.zh: 案占為營首，營首之下，流血滂沲。

translations.literal: According to the prognostication it was Camp Head; beneath Camp Head blood flows in torrents.
translations.idiomatic: The omen identified it as Camp Head; wherever Camp Head appeared, blood poured below in unending streams.

sentences.zh: 七月壬子，歲星犯東井距星。

translations.literal: On renzi day in the seventh month Jupiter encroached on the distance star of the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a renzi day in the seventh month Jupiter trespassed against the Eastern Well's separating star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Internal disorder and armies will rise."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Civil strife and war would break out."

translations.literal: On wuxu day in the eighth month Mars entered the Carriage Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuxu day in the eighth month Mars entered the Carriage Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Loyal ministers will be killed."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Faithful ministers would be slaughtered."

translations.literal: On bingchen day Venus entered the Southern Dipper and encroached on the fourth star.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingchen day Venus entered the Southern Dipper and trespassed against its fourth star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Generals will rebel."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Generals would rise in revolt."

translations.literal: Another reading: "The chancellor will be dismissed."
translations.idiomatic: A second interpretation: "The chief minister would be removed."

sentences.zh: 」九年二月乙巳，入南斗，犯第三星。

translations.literal: On yisi day in the second month of the ninth year Venus entered the Southern Dipper and encroached on the third star.
translations.idiomatic: On a yisi day in the second month of Yonghe 9 Venus entered the Southern Dipper and trespassed against its third star.

translations.literal: On wuchen day in the third month the moon encroached on the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuchen day in the third month the moon trespassed against the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 八月，歲星犯輿鬼東南星。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Jupiter encroached on the southeastern star of the Carriage Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Jupiter trespassed against the southeastern star of the Carriage Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication: "The southeastern star governs warfare; armies will rise."
translations.idiomatic: The reading held: "The southeastern star presides over war—armies would rise."

sentences.zh: 十二月，月在東井，犯歲星。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the moon was in the Eastern Well and encroached on Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the moon stood in the Eastern Well and trespassed against Jupiter.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The hungry people of Qin will disperse in flight."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Starving masses in Qin would flee abroad."

sentences.zh: 」是時帝主幼沖，母后稱制，將相有隙，兵革連起。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor was young; the empress dowager held power; generals and chancellors had rifts between them; weapons and war arose in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was still a child, the empress dowager ruled in his stead, commanders and ministers were at odds, and war followed war without respite.

sentences.zh: 慕容儁僭稱大燕，攻伐無已，故災異數見，殷浩見廢也。

translations.literal: Murong Jun presumptuously styled himself Great Yan and attacked without cease; therefore portents and anomalies repeatedly appeared, and Yin Hao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Jun had declared himself emperor of Great Yan and waged unending war—hence the repeated omens in the sky, and hence Yin Hao's fall from power.

sentences.zh: 永和十年正月乙卯，月食昴。

translations.literal: On yimao day in the first month of the tenth year of Yonghe the moon eclipsed the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On a yimao day in the first month of Yonghe 10 the moon occulted the Hairy Head asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Zhao and Wei will see warfare."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War would come to Zhao and Wei."

translations.literal: On guiyou day Saturn covered the Halberd star.
translations.idiomatic: On a guiyou day Saturn overshadowed the Halberd star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Axes and halberds will be employed."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The executioner's axe would be put to use."

translations.literal: On jiashen day in the second month the moon encroached on the great star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiashen day in the second month the moon trespassed against the principal star of the Heart.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The king finds it ominous."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The sovereign would reckon it ill."

sentences.zh: 」四月癸未，流星大如斗，色赤黃，出織女，沒造父，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On guiwei day in the fourth month a meteor as large as the Dipper, red-yellow in color, issued from the Weaving Maid and vanished at Zaofu, with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On a guiwei day in the fourth month a meteor the size of the Dipper bowl, reddish-yellow in hue, burst from the Weaving Maid asterism and expired at Zaofu with a thunderous roar.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Yan and Qi will see warfare; the people will disperse in flight."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War would strike Yan and Qi, and the people would flee."

translations.literal: On wuwu day the moon encroached on the great star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuwu day the moon trespassed against the principal star of the Heart.

translations.literal: On gengwu day in the seventh month Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengwu day in the seventh month Venus shone by day.

translations.literal: Calculating by gnomon measures, the calamity lay in Qin and Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: By reckoning from the gnomon readings, the affliction would fall on Qin and Zheng.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，太白犯左執法。

translations.literal: On xinyou day in the ninth month Venus encroached on the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinyou day in the ninth month Venus trespassed against the Left Law Enforcer star.

sentences.zh: 十一月，月奄填星，在輿鬼。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the moon covered Saturn in the Carriage Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the moon occulted Saturn while it stood in the Carriage Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Qin will see warfare."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War would break out in Qin."

translations.literal: On xinhai day in the third month of the eleventh year the moon covered Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinhai day in the third month of Yonghe 11 the moon occulted Xuanyuan.

translations.literal: The prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The omen reading matched that given above.

sentences.zh: 四月庚寅，月犯牛宿南星。

translations.literal: On gengyin day in the fourth month the moon encroached on the southern star of the Ox asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengyin day in the fourth month the moon trespassed against the southern star of the Ox constellation.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The state will have distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The realm would know alarm."

translations.literal: On jiwei day in the eighth month Venus encroached on the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiwei day in the eighth month Venus trespassed against the Celestial River asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The river fords will be impassable."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "River crossings would be blocked."

sentences.zh: 」十二年六月庚子，太白晝見，在東井。

translations.literal: On gengzi day in the sixth month of the twelfth year Venus was visible in daylight in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengzi day in the sixth month of Yonghe 12 Venus shone by day in the Eastern Well asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication is as above.
translations.idiomatic: The omen reading was as given above.

translations.literal: On jiwei day the moon encroached on the Halberd star.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiwei day the moon trespassed against the Halberd star.

sentences.zh: 七月丁卯，太白犯填星，在柳。

translations.literal: On dingmao day in the seventh month Venus encroached on Saturn in the Willow.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingmao day in the seventh month Venus trespassed against Saturn in the Willow asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Zhou region will see great warfare."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Great armies would rise in the Zhou territories."

translations.literal: On guiyou day in the eighth month the moon covered the Establishment star.
translations.idiomatic: On a guiyou day in the eighth month the moon occulted the Establishment asterism.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，熒惑入太微，犯西蕃上將星。

translations.literal: On wuyin day in the ninth month Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and encroached on the western rampart's Senior General star.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuyin day in the ninth month Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and trespassed against the Senior General star on the western rampart.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，熒惑犯太微東蕃上相。

translations.literal: On dingchou day in the eleventh month Mars encroached on the Supreme Palace Enclosure's eastern rampart Senior Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingchou day in the eleventh month Mars trespassed against the Senior Minister star on the eastern rampart of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十年四月，桓溫伐苻健，破其嶢柳眾軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the tenth year Huan Wen attacked Fu Jian and defeated his Yaoliu host army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Yonghe 10 Huan Wen marched against Fu Jian and routed the Yaoliu army.

translations.literal: Jian fortified Chang'an; Wen withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jian held Chang'an behind walls, and Huan Wen withdrew.

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Murong Ke attacked Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Murong Ke besieged Qi.

sentences.zh: 十二年八月，桓溫破姚襄於伊水，定周地。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twelfth year Huan Wen defeated Yao Xiang at the Yi River and settled the Zhou region.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Yonghe 12 Huan Wen crushed Yao Xiang at the Yi River and secured the Zhou territories.

sentences.zh: 十一月，齊城陷，執段龕，殺三千餘人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Qi city fell; Duan Kan was captured and more than three thousand people were killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Qi fell; Duan Kan was taken prisoner and more than three thousand were put to death.

sentences.zh: 永和末，鮮卑侵略河、冀，升平元年，慕容儁遂據臨漳，盡有幽、并、青、冀之地。

translations.literal: At the end of Yonghe the Xianbei invaded and plundered He and Ji; in the first year of Shengping Murong Jun then occupied Linzhang and wholly held the lands of You, Bing, Qing, and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In the closing years of Yonghe the Xianbei raided He and Ji; in Shengping 1 Murong Jun seized Linzhang and came to hold all of You, Bing, Qing, and Ji.

sentences.zh: 緣河諸將漸奔散，河津隔絕矣。

translations.literal: The generals along the river gradually fled and scattered; the river crossings were cut off.
translations.idiomatic: The commanders along the Yellow River gradually broke and fled, and the river fords were severed.

sentences.zh: 三年，會稽王以郗曇、謝萬敗績，求自貶三等。

translations.literal: In the third year the Prince of Kuaiji, because of the defeats of Xi Tan and Xie Wan, asked to demote himself by three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In Shengping 3 the Prince of Kuaiji, on account of the defeats suffered by Xi Tan and Xie Wan, petitioned to lower his own rank by three degrees.

sentences.zh: 是時權在方伯，九服交兵，故譴象仍見。

translations.literal: At that time power lay with the regional lords and the nine domains exchanged arms; therefore reproving portents continued to appear.
translations.idiomatic: Power then rested with the regional strongmen and war crossed every domain of the empire; hence chastising omens kept appearing.

sentences.zh: 晉穆帝升平元年四月壬子，太白入輿鬼。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Shengping of Emperor Mu of Jin, on renzi day Venus entered the Carriage Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On a renzi day in the fourth month of Shengping 1, during the reign of Emperor Mu of Jin, Venus entered the Carriage Ghost asterism.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，月奄東井南轅西頭第二星。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the moon covered the second star at the western end of the southern axle of the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a dinghai day the moon occulted the second star at the western end of the Eastern Well's southern axle.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Qin territory will see warfare."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War would break out in the Qin region."

translations.literal: Another reading: "A general will die."
translations.idiomatic: A second interpretation: "A field commander would perish."

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuxu day Venus was visible in daylight in the Chariot Pivot.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuxu day in the sixth month Venus shone by day in the Chariot Pivot asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The omen reading matched that given above.

translations.literal: The Chariot Pivot is the allotment of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: The Chariot Pivot asterism governed the Chu region.

translations.literal: On renzi day the moon encroached on the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On a renzi day the moon trespassed against the Net asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends border warfare."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "It foretold war on the frontiers."

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on xinsi day Mars encroached on the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinsi day in the seventh month Mars trespassed against the Celestial River asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The river fords will be impassable."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "River crossings would be blocked."

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Jupiter encroached on the Room.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Jupiter trespassed against the Room asterism.

translations.literal: On renwu day the moon covered Jupiter in the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a renwu day the moon occulted Jupiter in the Room asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The people will suffer famine."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The people would go hungry."

translations.literal: Another reading: "Yuzhou will suffer calamity."
translations.idiomatic: A second interpretation: "Yuzhou would know disaster."

sentences.zh: 」二年二月辛卯，填星犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year, on xinmao day Saturn encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinmao day in the second month of Shengping 2 Saturn trespassed against the great star of Xuanyuan.

translations.literal: On jiawu day the moon encroached on the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiawu day the moon trespassed against the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙亥，月犯歲星，在房。

translations.literal: On yihai day in the intercalary month the moon encroached on Jupiter in the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a yihai day in the intercalary month the moon trespassed against Jupiter in the Room asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostications are all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The omen readings were all as given above.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，彗出天船，在胃度中。

translations.literal: On dinghai day in the fifth month a comet issued from the Celestial Ship in the midst of the Stomach degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On a dinghai day in the fifth month a comet rose from the Celestial Ship asterism within the Stomach lodge.

sentences.zh: 彗為兵喪，除舊布新，出天船，外夷侵。

translations.literal: Comets portend war and mourning, casting off the old and spreading the new; issuing from the Celestial Ship, foreign tribes invade.
translations.idiomatic: Comets foretell war and death, the overthrow of the old and the rise of the new; one issuing from the Celestial Ship means invasion by outer barbarians.

translations.literal: Another reading: "This portends great flood."
translations.idiomatic: A second interpretation: "It foretold catastrophic flooding."

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinyou day the moon encroached on the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinyou day in the sixth month the moon trespassed against the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，熒惑犯填星，在張。

translations.literal: On wuwu day in the eighth month Mars encroached on Saturn in the Extended Net.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuwu day in the eighth month Mars trespassed against Saturn in the Extended Net asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Great armies will rise."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War on a vast scale would break out."

translations.literal: The Extended Net is the allotment of the Three Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: The Extended Net asterism governed the Three Rivers region.

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on jiwei day Venus encroached on the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiwei day in the tenth month Venus trespassed against the Weeping Star.

sentences.zh: 十二月，枉矢自東南流于西北，其長半天。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month a Crooked Arrow star flowed from the southeast toward the northwest; its length spanned half the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month a Crooked Arrow comet streamed from the southeast toward the northwest, its tail stretching halfway across the heavens.

sentences.zh: 三年正月壬辰，熒惑犯楗閉。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, on renchen day Mars encroached on the Gate Bolt and Closer.
translations.idiomatic: On a renchen day in the first month of Shengping 3 Mars trespassed against the Gate Bolt and Closer asterism.

translations.literal: According to the prognostications, "The ruler will be troubled."
translations.idiomatic: The established reading held that the sovereign would face grave anxiety.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，熒惑逆行犯鉤鈐。

translations.literal: On yiyou day in the third month Mars turned retrograde and encroached on the Hooked Clasp.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiyou day in the third month Mars turned retrograde and trespassed against the Hooked Clasp asterism.

translations.literal: According to the prognostications, "The king finds it ominous."
translations.idiomatic: The established reading held that the sovereign would reckon it ill.

translations.literal: The moon encroached on Venus in the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: The moon trespassed against Venus in the Hairy Head asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The ruler will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The sovereign would perish."

translations.literal: Another reading: "Zhao territory will see warfare; the court will be unsettled."
translations.idiomatic: A second interpretation: "War would rise in the Zhao region and the court would know unrest."

translations.literal: In the sixth month Venus encroached on the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Venus trespassed against the Eastern Well asterism.

translations.literal: On yiyou day in the seventh month Mars encroached on the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiyou day in the seventh month Mars trespassed against the Celestial River asterism.

translations.literal: On bingxu day Venus encroached on the Carriage Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingxu day Venus trespassed against the Carriage Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostications are all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The omen readings were all as given above.

sentences.zh: 戊子，月犯牽牛中央大星。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the moon encroached on the central great star of the Lead Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuzi day the moon trespassed against the central great star of the Lead Ox asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Lead Ox is the celestial general."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The Lead Ox is the star of heaven's general."

translations.literal: Encroaching on the central star means the Great General will die.
translations.idiomatic: Trespass against its central star and the commander-in-chief would perish.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingwei day Venus encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingwei day in the eighth month Venus trespassed against the great star of Xuanyuan.

translations.literal: On jiazi day the moon encroached on the great star of the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiazi day the moon trespassed against the great star of the Net asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends border warfare."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "It foretold war on the frontiers."

translations.literal: Another reading: "The inferior encroaches on the superior."
translations.idiomatic: A second interpretation: "The low would trespass against the high."

translations.literal: On gengwu day Venus encroached on Saturn in the midst of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengwu day Venus trespassed against Saturn within the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The king finds it ominous."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The sovereign would reckon it ill."

sentences.zh: 」二年五月，關中氐帥殺苻生立堅。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year the Di chieftains of Guanzhong killed Fu Sheng and enthroned Jian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Shengping 2 the Di chieftains of Guanzhong murdered Fu Sheng and raised Fu Jian to the throne.

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Murong Jun entered and encamped at Ye.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Murong Jun marched in and encamped at Ye.

sentences.zh: 八月，安西將軍、豫州刺史謝弈薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Xie Yi, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yuzhou, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Xie Yi, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yuzhou, passed away.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，諸葛攸舟軍入河，敗績。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year Zhuge You's river fleet entered the Yellow River and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Shengping 3 Zhuge You led a fleet up the Yellow River and met defeat.

sentences.zh: 豫州刺史謝萬入潁，眾潰而歸，除名為民。

translations.literal: Xie Wan, Inspector of Yuzhou, entered Ying; his host collapsed and fled home, and he was stripped of rank and made a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Wan, Inspector of Yuzhou, marched into Ying; his army broke and fled, and he was dismissed from office and reduced to commoner status.
