sentences.zh: 十一月，司徒會稽王以二鎮敗，求自貶三等。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Minister over the Masses, the Prince of Kuaiji, because of the defeats of the two garrisons, asked to demote himself by three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Minister over the Masses, the Prince of Kuaiji, on account of the twin garrison defeats, petitioned to lower his own rank by three degrees.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，慕容儁死，子暐代立。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year Murong Jun died and his son Wei succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Shengping 4 Murong Jun died and his son Wei ascended in his place.

sentences.zh: 慕容恪殺其尚書令陽騖等。

translations.literal: Murong Ke killed his Minister of the Interior Yang Yu and others.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Ke executed his Minister of the Interior Yang Yu and his associates.

translations.literal: In the fifth month the realm suffered great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month catastrophic flooding struck the empire.

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year Emperor Mu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Shengping 5 Emperor Mu passed away.

sentences.zh: 升平四年正月乙亥，月犯牽牛中央大星。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year of Shengping, on yihai day the moon encroached on the central great star of the Lead Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On a yihai day in the first month of Shengping 4 the moon trespassed against the central great star of the Lead Ox asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "A great general will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A great general would perish."

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinhai day Mercury encroached on Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinhai day in the sixth month Mercury trespassed against Xuanyuan.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The chief consort will suffer distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The empress would be afflicted."

sentences.zh: 」己未，太白入太微右掖門，從端門出。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Venus entered the Right Rear Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure and departed through the End Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiwei day Venus entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure by the Right Rear Gate and passed out through the End Gate.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The noble will be stripped of power."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The mighty would lose their standing."

translations.literal: Another reading: "There will be warfare."
translations.idiomatic: A second interpretation: "War would follow."

translations.literal: It also says: "Departing through the End Gate—ministers cease to be ministers."
translations.idiomatic: Another line read: "Passing out through the End Gate means subjects will no longer serve as subjects."

translations.literal: On wushen day in the eighth month Venus encroached on the Root.
translations.idiomatic: On a wushen day in the eighth month Venus trespassed against the Root asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The state will have distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The realm would know alarm."

translations.literal: On bingchen day Mars encroached on the Supreme Palace Enclosure's western rampart Senior General.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingchen day Mars trespassed against the Senior General star on the western rampart of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，太白入南斗口，犯第四星。

translations.literal: On renwu day in the ninth month Venus entered the mouth of the Southern Dipper and encroached on the fourth star.
translations.idiomatic: On a renwu day in the ninth month Venus entered the mouth of the Southern Dipper and trespassed against its fourth star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為喪，有赦，天下受爵祿。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends mourning; there will be an amnesty, and the realm will receive ranks and emoluments."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "It foretold mourning, an amnesty, and the bestowal of ranks and stipends throughout the empire."

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on gengxu day the Heavenly Dog appeared in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengxu day in the tenth month the Heavenly Dog was seen in the southwest.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be great armies and flowing blood."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Great armies would clash and blood would flow."

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiayin day Mars encroached on the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiayin day in the twelfth month Mars trespassed against the Room asterism.

translations.literal: On bingyin day Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingyin day Venus shone by day.

translations.literal: On gengyin day the moon encroached on the Gate Bolt and Closer.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengyin day the moon trespassed against the Gate Bolt and Closer asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The ruler finds it ominous."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The sovereign would reckon it ill."

sentences.zh: 」五年正月乙巳，填星逆行犯太微。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, on yisi day Saturn turned retrograde and encroached on the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On a yisi day in the first month of Shengping 5 Saturn turned retrograde and trespassed against the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 乙丑辰時，月在危宿奄太白。

translations.literal: At the chen hour on yichou day the moon in the Rooftop asterism covered Venus.
translations.idiomatic: At the chen hour on a yichou day the moon, standing in the Rooftop asterism, occulted Venus.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The people throughout the realm will scatter and disperse."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The people of the empire would be driven apart and scattered."

translations.literal: On dingwei day in the third month the moon encroached on Saturn in the Chariot Pivot.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingwei day in the third month the moon trespassed against Saturn in the Chariot Pivot asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends great mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "It foretold death on an imperial scale."

translations.literal: On renyin day in the fifth month the moon encroached on the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On a renyin day in the fifth month the moon trespassed against the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

translations.literal: On gengxu day the moon encroached on the Establishment star.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengxu day the moon trespassed against the Establishment asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Great ministers will slander one another."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "High ministers would turn accuser against one another."

translations.literal: On xinhai day the moon encroached on the Lead Ox asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinhai day the moon trespassed against the Lead Ox asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The state will have distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The realm would know alarm."

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year Xi Tan, General of the Gentlemen of the Household for the North, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Shengping 5 Xi Tan, General of the Gentlemen of the Household for the North, passed away.

sentences.zh: 五月，穆帝崩，哀帝立，大赦賜爵，褚后失勢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Emperor Mu died; Emperor Ai ascended; a general amnesty was granted and ranks bestowed; Empress Chu lost her power.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Emperor Mu passed away and Emperor Ai ascended the throne; a general amnesty was proclaimed and ranks conferred, and Empress Dowager Chu lost her influence.

sentences.zh: 七月，慕容恪攻冀州刺史呂護於野王，拔之，護奔滎陽。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Murong Ke attacked Lü Hu, Inspector of Jizhou, at Yewang, took it, and Hu fled to Xingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Murong Ke besieged Lü Hu, Inspector of Jizhou, at Yewang, captured the city, and Hu fled to Xingyang.

sentences.zh: 是時桓溫以大眾次宛，聞護敗乃退。

translations.literal: At that time Huan Wen, with a great host, halted at Wan; when he heard of Hu's defeat he withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Huan Wen had encamped a great army at Wan; hearing of Hu's defeat, he pulled back.

sentences.zh: 升平五年六月癸酉，月奄氐東北星。

translations.literal: On guiyou day in the sixth month of the fifth year of Shengping, the moon covered the northeastern star of the Root asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On a guiyou day in the sixth month of Shengping 5, the moon occulted the northeastern star of the Root asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "A great general will bear it."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A great general would bear the consequence."

translations.literal: On yiyou day in the ninth month, it covered the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiyou day in the ninth month, the moon covered the Net asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be border armies."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Armies would stir on the frontier."

sentences.zh: 」十月丁卯，熒惑犯歲星，在營室。

translations.literal: On dingmao day in the tenth month Mars encroached on Jupiter in the Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingmao day in the tenth month Mars trespassed against Jupiter in the Encampment asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Great ministers harbor hidden designs."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "High ministers would conceal secret plots."

translations.literal: Another reading: "There will be warfare in the Wei region."
translations.idiomatic: A second interpretation: "War would break out in the Wei territory."

translations.literal: On dingwei day the moon encroached on the red star of the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingwei day the moon trespassed against the red star of the Net asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Inferiors will offend superiors."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Those below would rise against those above."

translations.literal: It also reads: "There will be border armies."
translations.idiomatic: It also foretold armies on the frontier.

translations.literal: In the eighth month Fan Wang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Fan Wang was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 隆和元年，慕容暐遣傅末波寇河陰，陳祐危逼。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longhe Murong Wei sent Fu Mobo to raid Heyin, and Chen You was pressed to the brink.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longhe Murong Wei dispatched Fu Mobo to raid Heyin, leaving Chen You in dire peril.

sentences.zh: 晉哀帝興寧元年八月，星孛大角亢，入天市。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Xingning of Emperor Ai of Jin, a broom star appeared at the Horn and Knees and entered the Celestial Market.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Xingning, during the reign of Emperor Ai of Jin, a comet blazed at the Horn and Knees and swept into the Celestial Market.

translations.literal: According to the prognostication, "this portends war and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The reading was: "War and mourning would follow."

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year Empress Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year Empress Wang passed away.

translations.literal: In the second month Emperor Ai died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Emperor Ai died.

sentences.zh: 三月，慕容恪攻洛陽，沈勁等戰死。

translations.literal: In the third month Murong Ke attacked Luoyang; Shen Jin and others died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Murong Ke assaulted Luoyang, and Shen Jin and others fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 興寧元年十月丙戌，月奄太白，在須女。

translations.literal: On bingxu day in the tenth month of the first year of Xingning the moon covered Venus in the Maid.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingxu day in the tenth month of Xingning 1, the moon occulted Venus in the Maid asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The people throughout the realm will scatter and disperse."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The people of the empire would be driven apart and scattered."

translations.literal: Another reading: "The calamity will fall on Yangzhou."
translations.idiomatic: A second interpretation: "The disaster would strike Yangzhou."

translations.literal: In the third year Luoyang fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Luoyang was lost.

sentences.zh: 其後桓溫傾揚州資實，討鮮卑敗績，死亡太半，及征袁真，淮南殘破。

translations.literal: Thereafter Huan Wen drained Yangzhou's resources and stores; his campaign against the Xianbei ended in defeat and more than half died; when he marched against Yuan Zhen, Huainan was ravaged and broken.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Huan Wen emptied Yangzhou of its wealth and supplies; his campaign against the Xianbei ended in rout, with more than half his men dead, and when he marched against Yuan Zhen, Huainan was laid waste.

sentences.zh: 後氐及東胡侵逼，兵役無已。

translations.literal: Later the Di and the Eastern Hu pressed in, and military service had no end.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Di and the Eastern Hu pressed ever closer, and conscription knew no respite.

sentences.zh: 興寧三年正月乙卯，月奄歲星，在參。

translations.literal: On yimao day in the first month of the third year of Xingning the moon covered Jupiter in the Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: On a yimao day in the first month of Xingning 3, the moon occulted Jupiter in the Three Stars asterism.

translations.literal: The Three Stars are the partition of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Stars asterism is the celestial correlate of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，鎮西將軍、益州刺史周撫薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Zhou Fu, General Who Guards the West and Inspector of Yizhou, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Zhou Fu, General Who Guards the West and Inspector of Yizhou, passed away.

sentences.zh: 十月，梁州刺史司馬勳入益州以叛，朱序率眾助刺史周楚討平之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Sima Xun, Inspector of Liangzhou, entered Yizhou in rebellion; Zhu Xu led troops to aid Inspector Zhou Chu in suppressing and pacifying him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Sima Xun, Inspector of Liangzhou, entered Yizhou in revolt; Zhu Xu rallied forces to help Inspector Zhou Chu crush the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 興寧三年七月庚戌，月犯南斗。

translations.literal: On gengxu day in the seventh month of the third year of Xingning the moon encroached on the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengxu day in the seventh month of Xingning 3, the moon trespassed against the Southern Dipper.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The empress will know distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The empress would know grief."

translations.literal: Jupiter encroached on the Chariot and Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter trespassed against the Chariot and Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The ruler will know distress."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The sovereign would know alarm."

translations.literal: In the tenth month Venus was visible in daylight in the Knees.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Venus shone by day in the Knees asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「亢為朝廷，有兵喪，為臣強。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Knees signify the court; there will be war and mourning, and ministers will grow strong."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The Knees stand for the imperial court—war and mourning would follow, and ministers would grow overmighty."

sentences.zh: 」哀帝是年二月崩，其災皆在海西也。

translations.literal: Emperor Ai died in the second month of that year; all these calamities would fall upon Haixi.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ai died that second month; every calamity foretold would instead befall the Deposed Emperor.

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the following year Empress Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the following year Empress Yu passed away.

sentences.zh: 晉海西太和元年二日丙子，月奄熒惑，在參。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taihe of the Deposed Emperor of Jin, on bingzi day in the second month the moon covered Mars in the Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingzi day in the second month of the first year of Taihe, during the reign of the Deposed Emperor of Jin, the moon occulted Mars in the Three Stars asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends internal disorder."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "It foretold civil strife."

translations.literal: Another reading: "The Three Stars are Wei territory."
translations.idiomatic: A second interpretation: "The Three Stars asterism corresponds to Wei territory."

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year Venus entered the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year Venus entered the Hairy Head asterism.

sentences.zh: 五年，慕容暐為苻堅所滅，司、冀、幽、并四州並屬氐。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Murong Wei was destroyed by Fu Jian; the four provinces of Si, Ji, You, and Bing all came under the Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Murong Wei was overthrown by Fu Jian, and the four provinces of Si, Ji, You, and Bing all passed into Di hands.

sentences.zh: 太和二年八月戊午，太白犯歲星，在太微。

translations.literal: On wuwu day in the eighth month of the second year of Taihe Venus encroached on Jupiter in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuwu day in the eighth month of Taihe 2, Venus trespassed against Jupiter in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 三年六月甲寅，太白奄熒惑，在太微端門中。

translations.literal: On jiayin day in the sixth month of the third year Venus covered Mars in the Front Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiayin day in the sixth month of the third year Venus occulted Mars within the Front Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

translations.literal: In the sixth year the Deposed Duke of the West was deposed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the Deposed Emperor was himself deposed.

sentences.zh: 太和四年二月，客星見紫宮西垣，至七月乃滅。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year of Taihe a guest star appeared at the western rampart of the Purple Palace and did not vanish until the seventh month.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Taihe 4 a guest star appeared at the western wall of the Purple Palace and lingered until the seventh month before fading.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「客星守紫宮，臣殺主。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "When a guest star lodges at the Purple Palace, ministers will slay their lord."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A guest star holding station at the Purple Palace means ministers will kill their sovereign."

sentences.zh: 」閏月乙亥，月暈軫，復有白暈貫月，北暈斗柄三星。

translations.literal: On yihai day in the intercalary month a halo ringed the moon at the Chariot Pivot; again a white halo pierced the moon, and to the north a halo encircled the three stars of the Dipper handle.
translations.idiomatic: On a yihai day in the intercalary month a lunar halo appeared at the Chariot Pivot; then a white halo ran through the moon, and to the north another halo ringed the three stars of the Dipper handle.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The sovereign finds it ominous."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The ruler would reckon it ill."

translations.literal: In the sixth year Huan Wen deposed the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Huan Wen deposed the emperor.

sentences.zh: 太和四年十月壬申，有大流星西下，聲如雷。

translations.literal: On renshen day in the tenth month of the fourth year of Taihe a great meteor streaked westward, its sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On a renshen day in the tenth month of Taihe 4 a great meteor plunged westward with a thunderous roar.

sentences.zh: 案占，「流星為貴使，星大者使大」。

translations.literal: According to the prognostication, "Meteors signify eminent envoys; the greater the star, the greater the envoy."
translations.idiomatic: The reading held that meteors betokened high emissaries—the brighter the star, the loftier the messenger.

sentences.zh: 明年，遣使免袁真為庶人。

translations.literal: The following year envoys were dispatched to dismiss Yuan Zhen and reduce him to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: The following year imperial envoys were sent to strip Yuan Zhen of office and reduce him to commoner rank.

sentences.zh: 桓溫征壽春，真病死，息瑾代立，求救於苻堅，溫破氐軍。

translations.literal: Huan Wen marched against Shouchun; Zhen died of illness; his son Jin succeeded him and sought rescue from Fu Jian; Wen defeated the Di army.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen marched on Shouchun; Yuan Zhen died of illness, and his son Jin took his place and appealed to Fu Jian for aid; Wen routed the Di forces.

sentences.zh: 六年，壽春城陷，聲如雷，將士怒之象也。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Shouchun fell; the sound like thunder was an image of the anger of generals and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Shouchun fell—the thunderous crash was an image of the fury of generals and troops.

sentences.zh: 太和六年閏月，熒惑守太微端門。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month of the sixth year of Taihe Mars lodged at the Front Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month of Taihe 6 Mars held station at the Front Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Son of Heaven will lose the state."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The emperor would lose his realm."

translations.literal: It also reads: "Feudal lords and the three dukes will plot against their sovereign."
translations.idiomatic: It also foretold that regional lords and the three highest ministers would conspire against the throne.

translations.literal: Another reading: "There will be executed ministers."
translations.idiomatic: A second interpretation: "Ministers would be put to death."

translations.literal: On xinmao day the moon encroached on the major star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinmao day the moon trespassed against the major star of the Heart asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The sovereign finds it ominous."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The ruler would reckon it ill."

sentences.zh: 」十一月，桓溫廢帝，并奏誅武陵王，簡文不許，溫乃徙之新安。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Huan Wen deposed the emperor and also memorialized for the execution of the Prince of Wuling; Emperor Jianwen did not consent, and Wen then relocated him to Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Huan Wen deposed the emperor and petitioned for the execution of the Prince of Wuling; Emperor Jianwen refused, and Wen had the prince banished to Xin'an.
